license: MIT; original procedural texture patterns and material constants

encoding.BCR: Standard piecewise linear-to-sRGB encoding of source albedo into RGB; roughness copied directly to alpha as a candidate convention
encoding.NMO: Linear channels: flat normal X/Y encoded as 128/255, metalness in B, occlusion 255 in A
encoding.import: TIFFResourceClass PC; ColorHQCompression; explicit ToSRGB for BCR and ToLinear for NMO; generated mipmaps
encoding.quantization: Clamp to [0,1], multiply by 255 and round to nearest with floor(x+0.5)
encoding.limitation: No calibrated BRDF/roughness or photometric equivalence to Cycles is asserted

case_changes.orientation: Original color constants on other materials; neutral uses a repeated asymmetric color pattern in BCR and flat dielectric NMO
case_changes.packed: All seven materials use original candidate BCR/NMO constants; Color multiplier white
case_changes.metal-matte: Same as packed except intended metal material BCR alpha encodes roughness 0.85 instead of 0.15
case_changes.metal-dielectric: Same as packed except intended metal material NMO B channel is 0 instead of 255

orientation_pattern: Each 128x128 tile: top-left red, top-right green, bottom-left blue, bottom-right yellow; 8px white L along top and left tile edges. Pixel origin is image top-left.
orientation_probe_coordinates: Enfusion local [x,height,z]; back wall front surface; project using verified camera and compare with TXO face UVs. No fitted screen alignment.
response_acceptance: Report pixel changes in the preselected intended-metal sphere region and inspect full images; any change alone does not establish physical BRDF correctness
limits: Outdoor illumination is not the reference area light
Textures and raster response need native verification before acceptance
